But the image shows green squares at the gap and on the left panel. These might be part of the panel backgrounds, not separate objects.

- Left panel: light gray background with c frame containing w square
- Gap: light gray corridor with a green (N=light green) square
- Right panel: light gray background with c frame containing w square
- Purple bar between panels
- N(W) at (30,18) on left panel (dark border, white center)
- N(c) at (30,39) on right panel (dark border, charcoal center)
The green squares are N (light green) color, not w (light gray). So they're different from the w squares inside the c frames.
Wait, but the segmentation doesn't show any N (light green) squares as separate nodes. Let me check... The segmentation shows nodes with colors g, w, p, c, N, W. The N nodes are the dark-bordered squares with centers. The w nodes are the panel backgrounds and the w squares inside c frames.
Hmm, I think the green squares I see in the image might be the w squares inside the c frames, rendered with a different color due to lighting or something. Or they might be a different color entirely.
Let me focus on what I know:

2. Level not completed
3. I've tried many configurations without success

To swap positions, I need to:
1. Move N(W) to (30,39) - but N(W) can't move from left panel to right panel directly
2. Or swap colors and then move... but that doesn't change positions
Actually, I can't swap positions of N squares. The only way to change positions is to push one N square, which teleports it to the opposite panel.
Let me try: swap colors, then push N(W) (now at 30,18 with c center) into... but there's no other N square on the left panel to push.
Wait, I just realized something. The push mechanic requires N(W) to be adjacent to the other N square. Currently N(W) is at (30,18) and N(c) is at (30,39). They're not adjacent. N(W) would need to move RIGHT to reach N(c), but N(W) can only move to (30,21), (30,24), (30,27), (30,30) before hitting the purple bar.
So N(W) can never reach N(c) at (30,39) to push it. This means N(c) is stuck at (30,39) forever.
Given this, the only thing I can do is:
1. Move N(W) between (30,18), (30,21), (30,24), (30,27), (30,30)
2. Swap colors
Let me try all possible N(W) positions with both color configurations and see if any complete the level. I've already tried:

- N(W) at (30,30), N(c) at (30,39) - not completed
- N(W) at (30,30), N(W) at (30,39) [swap] - not completed
